1. Join the connecting rods to the pistons so that the gudgeon pin offset is facing the number stamped on the big end.

1. Test the gudgeon pin fit locking the connecting rod-piston assembly in the supporting tool (1a) and positioning a dial gauge for measuring the movement of the pin.

2. Act on the tool nut using a torque wrench set at a torque of 1.27 daNm equal to an axial load of 392.4 daN. The matching is correct if, when the action of the torque wrench is over and the nut is returned to its original simple contact position, the pointer on the dial gauge returns to zero. If this is not the case, replace the connecting rod.
